mapping: weapon-artwork.json item/model IDs, originally item.bin column 24.
scope: Base stats for each individual weapon, as shown in the item and forge menus. The game can calculate different combined stats for two swords; these are not character damage, a damage formula, or a saved individual weapon condition.
outsideCompletionNote: Ten item-mapped weapons outside the completion list are included for coverage. Their inclusion does not assert normal acquisition.
